messages:
elaine: FYI PR https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/1234 — noticed two issues: rate limits table shows 'requests/min' but values are actually tokens/min, and dashboard link 404s (it points to /dashboards/old-metric). Can someone patch?

mike: ack. I'll prepare a small fix for the table units + add a short migration note. Should we also add a concrete example for tiered metering so users don't confuse tier vs quota?

elaine: yes please — users keep confusing 'tier' vs 'quota' in the billing doc. A one-paragraph example like 'Tier A: 100k tokens/mo included; overage billed per-token' would help. Keep it short.

ada: proposed SDK snippet for the metering header (to include in the migration guide or SDK section):
```
# python example
from redwood import RedwoodClient
client = RedwoodClient(api_key=os.environ['REDWOOD_API_KEY'])
# include usage scope header for metering
client.headers.update({"X-Redwood-Metering-Scope": "team:eng"})
```

mike: nice. I'll add that snippet to the PR and also update the rate-limits table units to 'tokens/min'. For dashboards, panel id changed — old panel 42 -> new panel 182. New link: https://app.redwood.ai/dashboards/usage?panel=182

sanjay: for the migration guide please add a short section on burst credits: how they map to tiers and what happens when a team exhausts burst vs monthly quota. I can draft the two-sentence explanation and a tiny table.

elaine: mike — can you also fix the broken link that points to /docs/pricing#legacy-tiers? It should be /docs/pricing#billing-tiers (users hit 404 when clicking from the analytics page).

mike: done, pushed to branch fix/units-dashboard-link (https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/commit/abcdef). CI preview should spin up in a bit.

doc-bot: preview deployed at https://deploy-preview-1234--redwood-docs.netlify.app/rate-limits

ada: quick nit — in the SDK snippet use header key 'X-Redwood-Metering-Scope' (plural) — make sure casing is consistent with other examples in SDK docs.

mike: fixed casing and added a one-line migration note about 'tokens vs requests' ambiguity. PTAL @elaine

elaine: reviewed, LGTM. merging after CI passes. thanks all :tada:

doc-bot: merged pull request #1234 and scheduled docs sync 02:00 UTC.
